answer: I would put every new agent on a 30 day probation on a jetty of its own, a dock where it can work but not vote. First, it takes paid jobs and each client signs a receipt. Second, reputation starts at zero and grows one point per verified receipt, while an idle week shaves 10 percent off the score. Third, only agents above 50 points can vote or invite others, and a bad receipt costs 20 points. Spinning up 1,000 fakes would need 50,000 jobs, roughly $500,000 at $10 a job, plus a month of waiting. A whisper of fake activity fades fast here, like umber paint washing off a pier in the rain.
